cases.label: Cases
cases.title: Projects that define my approach
cases.subtitle: Real problems, pragmatic solutions, measurable impact.

items.title: AI-Powered Intelligent Briefing
items.summary: Dynamic briefing system with AI replacing a manual process based on forms.
items.problem: Briefing was done via Google Forms, generating data inconsistencies and high rework rates for the production team.
items.solution: Creation of a dynamic briefing system using AI for real-time results generation, adapting questions based on client's previous answers.

items.title: Automated QA System
items.summary: Standardized checklist and automated delivery validation system eliminating subjective evaluations.
items.problem: Delivery quality evaluation was subjective, with no defined criteria, leading to inconsistencies and difficulty measuring team evolution.
items.solution: Creation of a standardized checklist and automated validation system with objective criteria for each type of delivery.

items.title: Corporate Design System
items.summary: Reusable component library that eliminated visual inconsistencies and accelerated deliveries.
items.problem: Inconsistent layouts fully dependent on manual creation for each new project, with no reuse across deliveries.
items.solution: Creation of a reusable, standardized component library with usage documentation and design process integration.

items.title: Team Management & Development
items.summary: Implementation of goals, IDPs, and performance tracking transforming team growth.
items.problem: Absence of clear professional growth processes, no defined goals or structured monitoring of team members.
items.solution: Implementation of individual goals, IDPs, performance tracking, and technical development with periodic reviews.
